model.name: SFace-2021dec
model.fallback_reason: CUDAExecutionProvider not available in this onnxruntime build (available: ['AzureExecutionProvider', 'CPUExecutionProvider']); using CPU.

timing.note: per-image times come from the embedding cache (recorded when each image was first processed)

methodology: Dataset: original LFW (13,233 images, 5,749 identities) read from the local copy; labels = folder names.

Split: deterministic (SHA-256 of seed+path). Identities with >=2 images: up to 5 images (~30%) become queries, the rest go to the gallery, so every query identity has >=1 gallery image and no query image is in the gallery. Identities with 1 image: half are gallery distractors, half are 'unknown' queries (person absent from the gallery).
Gallery: every acceptable face (YuNet, quality filter) of every gallery photo is embedded and indexed (exact cosine search).
Query: the best-quality face (largest, most frontal, highest confidence) of the query photo, as the UI does by default.

Identification: ranked list of distinct gallery photos; a result is correct only if its identity equals the query identity. Queries where no face is detected count as misses in topK_accuracy (end-to-end) and are excluded in *_detected_only.
Open-set false matches: unknown-person queries; FMR(t) = share whose best gallery score is >= t.
Verification: threshold calibrated on gallery-vs-gallery pairs only, then tested on disjoint query-vs-gallery pairs.
limitations: LFW is mostly frontal, celebrity/news photos; studio passport photos differ (lighting, aging over years, glasses).
Many LFW identities have 2 images, so per-identity results rest on few samples; identity 'George W Bush' etc. are over-represented in micro averages.
Thresholds calibrated on LFW must be re-calibrated on studio data before any operational use.
Verification FMR floors: with N impostor pairs the smallest measurable FMR is ~1/N.
LFW may contain a small number of mislabeled/duplicate images; they are not corrected here.
Similarity ranking is a decision-support tool, not proof of identity.
